description: Draft, not published until co-designed with Weave. Something an organisation needs from the network, published in the open so others can answer it. Only public needs exist as records: an org-os instance's private and matching-only needs never leave it, so this lexicon has no visibility field. Deliberately small.

title.description: A short statement of the need.

text.description: The need in full: what, why, and what would help.

category.description: The area it falls in. The values follow the org-os needs/offers pack (from the network survey).

when.description: When it is needed, in free text (for example 'before March 2027' or 'ongoing').

status.description: Where the need stands. open: still needed. met: someone answered it. closed: no longer needed.
